options.notes: One respawning card per team plus a struck-out special-ready (camo) enemy row. Enemy row 1's label was corrected from Flingza Roller to Splat Roller when the art-cropped templates landed (white roll, blue L-frame, yellow-striped grip — matches the 1010 icon exactly). Enemy row 2 is both struck out and special-ready: the red dualie art reads through the X, but the Custom-vs-plain Dualie Squelchers tag is hidden behind a stroke, so the icon matcher near-ties the twins (5031 0.600 vs 5030 0.597); the row's sub tile (Splat Bomb silhouette, readable despite the stroke clipping it) breaks the tie to plain Dualie Squelchers (subResolved).
